name: time entries
description: Timesheet lines as recorded: hours one person worked on one day against one project, with the approval status and the billable, utilised and productive flags. Billed time carries the charge NetSuite raised for it: charged_amount, and charge_rate, the rate per hour it was charged at, in charge_currency.

project.label: project_name
project.description: The project the time was booked to.

approval.label: approval_name
approval.description: Open, Pending Approval, Approved, Rejected; empty on older lines.

charged_amount.description: What was charged for the time; empty for time with no charge.
